discovery_target: Previously unreported coordination in which distinguishable autonomous participants transfer a task result, instruction or artifact, the recipient demonstrably uses it, and primary evidence shows that the coordination crossed an operator-defined boundary.
selection: Completed the exact twelve-record repeated-host cursor saved by the prior assessment, rotated to ten further untouched exact-ID comparison absences forming five two-record submitted-host groups, then retried all five original-report reads retained as failures elsewhere in the repository. Every read succeeded. This is bounded original-record coverage, not participant attribution, a malware census or a novelty claim.
snapshot_limitations: The sanitized snapshots preserve original public report links, separate event and observation times, original-report hashes, domain-level traffic and bounded static-operation counts. They omit submitted paths and query values, request and response bodies, headers, submitter identifiers and recovered source. Manual correlation publishes only route and response-hash equality summaries, domain-level behavior and event ordering. Repeated content or a successful POST does not authenticate a participant or establish task use.
